title: How To Buy OneCoin From the Mandatory Trading Account
description: Subscribe to the channel and review more videos.

asr.full_text: Monday morning and one the first things that I do is use the trading account to purchase ONE coin. Now, if you don't do this each week the company will automatically purchase tokens for you at the end of the week and charge a processing fee. So what I like to do is to get in and use the trading account balance to go ahead and purchase one coin. Now we are going to open up a bit of an exchange, and go to Trading and click the big letters. O, N, E, and white. And now what you do here, is you have the number of coins ten being a minimum and you have the current buy price it's going to be 3.96 euros remember that this is why this value differs from the exchanges like x coin x that's showing u.s dollars and this is showing euros then you're going to see the transaction from the exchanges, like xCoinX, that's showing U.S. dollars, and this is showing Euros. Then you're gonna see the transaction value and you're gonna put in your transaction password. Now this is the same situation if you want to purchase one coin from your Cash account. These are the same exact steps, except that when you use the payment method, you can use any cash-only payment, or you use cash as an emergency account only. The amount will be €10175 or €10175 as well. Go to the graph editor and click Google. I don't spend any time wondering. The new account is 2569 who sees that we have a less than 1.76 euro. that's not enough to buy another one coin, why would I leave it alone. If you to use your cash account, you could again keep upping that number. Then once you're done, you're going to type in the transaction password and you're going to click Place Order. Then what will happen is that you'll see a window come up that says Order's being successfully placed. I already did this this morning so I I will not click on place order. But that is what happens. Now the second thing I want to share is that Sometimes in certain browsers you do not get a window that pops up but I want you to assume that a order was placed. If you were to press this button, again the order did not go through. They are also going to take it from your cash account as an order. Keep that in mind and place the order one time. Now at some point this week, you are going to see those coins that you purchased deposited into your one coyn total here on your dashboard now it is possible that if there's not enough 1 Coins being sold by other members through the week that the company will take your trading account and they will purchase tokens on your behalf which then get automatically submitted to earn OneCoins for you so if you don't see the OneCoins populate there don't worry about it, the company is taking care of that on your behalf

textual.observation: The title frames buying OneCoin through a stated mandatory trading account, while the ASR instructs use of that account to purchase coins with a minimum quantity and stated euro price.

you have the number of coins ten being a minimum and you have the current buy price it's going to be 3.96 euros

textual.context: Presented as an instructional purchase process; the source does not independently establish that the account is actually mandatory.
textual.potential_relevance: The stated account requirement is directly linked to a purchase action and acquisition of OneCoin, creating a task-relevant account-and-payment relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify the account requirement, the quoted price, the transaction's legitimacy, or whether any purchase occurred.

textual.observation: The speaker says that failing to purchase weekly may trigger an automatic token purchase and processing fee, and states that an order may be taken from the cash account.

textual.context: The automatic purchase and fee are described as conditional on weekly account activity.
textual.potential_relevance: A conditional automatic purchase and fee are linked to the account holder's weekly action and a stated cash-account debit, making the payment and authorization relationship relevant for later review.
textual.limitations: No fee amount, authorization terms, or evidence of an actual debit is provided.

visual.observation: A branded dashboard visibly shows “BONUS EARNED THIS WEEK,” “TOTAL BONUS EARNED,” “UNTIL NEXT BONUS ROUND,” and “DIRECTLY SPONSORED 44” alongside coin, cash-account, and trading-account balances.
visual.context: Interface context is unclear; the frames could represent promotional, training, historical, or ordinary account-dashboard use.
visual.potential_relevance: The display combines bonus/return tracking with a sponsorship- or recruitment-related metric, a relationship that may merit review if the source connects account activity or recruiting to those benefits.
visual.limitations: These frames do not show a recruitment instruction, payout terms, or whether the displayed balances are real, withdrawable, or redeemable.

visual.observation: A “Buy” order form visibly asks for a coin quantity, shows a EUR transaction value, requires selection of a payment method with mandatory account/cash-account wording, includes an expiry date and transaction-password field, and offers “PLACE ORDER.”
visual.context: The screen is an account or trading interface; whether it is a live transaction, demonstration, or historical capture is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: The frames show a concrete payment and authorization flow for acquiring coins, including account selection and transaction-password entry, presented within the same interface as bonus and sponsorship metrics.
visual.limitations: The samples do not establish that an order was submitted, that payment occurred, that the password was entered, or that any transaction completed.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it teaches viewers to purchase OneCoin from a trading balance, including a ten-coin minimum, a euro price, and entry of a transaction password. It reinforces the solicitation with claims about automatic token purchases, processing fees, future coin credits, and earning OneCoins, while advising viewers to assume an order succeeded without browser confirmation. The speaker does not execute the order on screen, and the available video evidence does not establish an actual charge, deposit, or realized return.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content demonstrates purchasing OneCoin through account balances and describes the purchased tokens being submitted to earn OneCoins. This supports a token-purchase-and-earning mechanism. The demonstrated order flow also explicitly requests a transaction password, supporting a separate sensitive-credential request.
